analysis.title: GS US TMT quick hits 6 Oct 2026
key_insights: NDX closed +50 bps while the R2K closed down about 50 bps. NDX has outperformed R2K on 14 of 16 sessions, with about 40% of NDX members lower on the day.

Breadth was mixed and volumes were measured. Investors debate chasing Tech/AI, which has been the only US equity story working over the last month, against waiting for a pullback as Semis, Mag 7 and Cyber approach overbought levels.

Top inbound question was why Semicap is lagging, especially KLAC and LRCX. Other inbounds: HDD names' direction, what is driving Cyber Security higher, the size of the SPHR pullback, weakness in OTAs (especially ABNB), and why TWLO is down 6%.
CRWD trades at about 40x forward EV/Sales, approaching the levels where it topped out in 2020/2021, when 10yr yields were about 1% versus the report's reference to yields approaching 5.5% now.

Investors question the durability of multiple expansion in Cyber Security and whether estimates will rise enough to support the multiples. The desk notes the trend has been positive and the thematic case for security remains hard to argue against.

Internet: ahead of 3Q earnings season, investors debate whether there will be follow-through beyond t+1, given top-down debates on Agentic Commerce and Oil/Rates. A chart plots US Internet against inverted oil prices.
There are few bottom-fishing calls across BKNG, EXPE, UBER, NFLX, PINS and APP, but the desk is getting 'any downside left' questions.
Big Tech: the AMZN chart appears to be trying to break above its recent downtrend after months of consolidation, ahead of better year-end seasonality.

Semis: Optical was up a lot while Memory and SPE were down a lot. Optics/Networking/Compute (AMD, ANET, LITE, MRVL) trade in the 40s on forward P/E, while NVDA, AVGO and TSM trade at a discount to the market.
Feedback attributes the semis multiple gap to gross margin trajectories or relative size (market cap or revenue). The desk notes valuations have been fluid over the last 3.5+ years.

Investors question follow-through into 3Q earnings given Agentic Commerce and Oil/Rates debates.
